# Test corpus

Meeting notes and volunteer applications written to exercise the extractors,
not to describe anything that happened. The names are invented.

The tests used to read `data/meeting_notes/`, which meant the real notes had to
keep carrying cases nobody would ever write on purpose: two action items worded
identically in one meeting, two follow-ups distinguished only by an `ID:` line,
a volunteer who withdrew. Those are worth testing and wrong to leave in a
document the team reads, so they live here instead.

Keep the awkward cases here. Keep the real notes readable.
